# a contraction (になっ for になってる). When a segment's
# first candidate has one stem of a group, another candidate of the same
# segment has another stem, the rest of the sentence contains a cue of the
# other stem and none of the first one, the other candidate moves first.
# Cues are matched as substrings of the other segments' text. For a group whose
# stems end in っ (担っ／になっ), a cue must be the word just before the segment.
